recordType: Reviewer transcription of selected facts from the original published body; not raw publisher bytes

facts.location: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.5.2 (carbonization, cooling, unloading); edition checked against x5328e00.htm
facts.smoke: Early white moisture smoke changes toward blue/transparent smoke as carbonisation progresses.
facts.opening: Premature opening can ignite charcoal and lose product; the kiln is cooled before unloading.
facts.reuse: Incompletely carbonised wood is separated and charged in a later batch.
facts.conditions_and_replicates: Operating instructions for brick kilns, not controlled double-pot trials; no replicate time series acquired.
